description: Fetch a single thread, including the human participant roster (`participantDetails` — userId, name, image) and bot roster (`identityParticipants` — id, name, isSystem). Use this when `naumu_list_threads` surfaced a candidate and you want to know exactly who is in it before posting. Pair with `naumu_read_thread` for message history.
name: naumu_get_thread
title: Get Thread
